capabilities: Create desktop and Start menu shortcuts to vaults, notes, folders, tags or other vaults
Open vaults, files, headings or blocks from a shortcut launch
Create notes, append or prepend text, or replace note contents on launch
Capture into today's daily note, create unique notes, or run folder, tag and custom searches
Customize shortcut icons and add Windows Send-to and agent integrations
disambiguation: Not keyboard hotkeys or Obsidian URIs; it builds OS-level desktop and Start menu shortcuts that launch vault actions.
extras: Windows fully supported; macOS and Linux experimental; mobile unsupported. Icons are stored outside the vault and survive uninstall, but copying a macOS shortcut can lose Finder icon metadata. File paths containing # are unsupported; duplicate shortcut names get numbered variants.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch a vault, jump to a note, or capture an idea directly from a desktop or Start menu shortcut.
